The user has provided a detailed scientific article about a study comparing PPV-guided GDFT with conventional fluid therapy in elderly patients undergoing laparoscopic colorectal surgery. First, I need to understand the structure of the article. It includes sections like Abstract, Introduction, Materials and Methods, Results, Discussion, and Supplementary Information. The Results section is particularly important for extracting the data.

Looking at the form, there are many fields to fill, such as n_randomized_gdft, n_randomized_control, surgery_type, etc. Each field requires the value as reported and the section where it was found.

Starting with n_randomized_gdft and n_randomized_control. The article mentions that 122 subjects were randomly assigned, with 61 in the PPV group and 61 in the control group. However, due to some patients not receiving the assigned intervention, the modified intention-to-treat analysis was done on 58 in the PPV group and 56 in the control group. So, I think the randomized numbers are 61 and 61, but the actual treated are 58 and 56. But the form asks for randomized, so I'll take 61 each.

Next, surgery_type is laparoscopic radical resection for colorectal cancer. Both groups had the same surgery, so the value is the same for both.

For laparoscopy_gdft and laparoscopy_control, since all surgeries were laparoscopic, both are 100%.

ASA distribution is given in Table 2. The PPV group has II:43.1%, III:56.9%, and the control group II:39.3%, III:60.7%. I'll represent this as a string.

Total fluid intake is in Table 3. PPV group had median 1450 ml, control 2100 ml. Crystalloids were 1100 ml vs 1600 ml, and colloids 500 ml each.

Blood loss is the same for both groups, around 50 ml.

Inotrope_use is tricky. Table 3 shows norepinephrine used in 25.9% vs 42.9%, and phenylephrine in 20.7% vs 42.9%. Since the form asks for inotrope_use, I'll combine these percentages, noting the significant difference.

Morbidity_events: PPV group had 19/58 (30.7%), control 32/56 (64.9%). Mortality is zero in both.

LOS: PPV was 11 days vs 13 days. Time to flatus, oral intake, defecation are all shorter in PPV group, but only defecation was significant.

Postop_ileus is part of gastrointestinal dysfunction, which was 11 vs 22 cases.

I need to make sure each value is correctly noted with the section it's from, like Results or Table 3. Also, if a value isn't reported, I should mark it as NR, but in this case, most data is available.

I'll structure the JSON accordingly, ensuring all fields are filled with the correct data points and their sources.
